name: @felafel/db
description: Runtime persistence layer for the Felafel orchestrator. Wraps better-sqlite3 + Drizzle ORM behind a single createDb() entry point that opens the SQLite database, applies migrations from this package's migrations/ directory, and returns a typed Drizzle handle. Schema and wire-shape Zod come from @felafel/contracts. Workspace-only; never published.
